text_block_list.text:
Worried about the Japanese Derby,

Matikanefukukitaru pays a visit to a
shrine to ask
a favor of the gods.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She happens to see Сайленс Судзука,
another
entrant in the Japanese Derby,
while she's there.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука says she has come to
pray that she
isn't overwhelmed by the
monster of a race that is
the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару realizes that,
despite her
amazing talents, Suzuka
views her as a rival.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her concerns put at ease,

Matikanefukukitaru offers up her own
prayers
alongside Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
